name: self_imitation_reinforce_v1
lr_note: Fixed before this run. Same learning rate used previously when REINFORCE started from these behavior-cloning checkpoints. Not tuned here.
elite_reference: greedy objective of the initial behavior-cloning checkpoint, frozen before updates
selection: lowest penalized greedy duration on dev_v2, all generated instances
returned_route: one greedy decode, cost_lambda 0, no local search
rl_claim_rule: On physically coverable dev_v2 instances, rl_imitation greedy duration is at least 1% below the imitation-only greedy duration, on at least 4 of 5 seeds, with a two-sided Student-t 95% interval entirely below zero. Beating the original behavior-cloning checkpoint is not sufficient.
description: imitation trains only the detached elite-action cross-entropy. rl_imitation adds leave-one-out REINFORCE on two on-policy samples. Both modes run the same narrow guided search and the same number of samples.
